mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: its explanation connected volcanic heat, circulating seawater and chemical energy clearly.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the continent was less engaging on its own; it became meaningful once rainfall weathered it.

surprise.text: Earth and water produced pigment rather than material for the mineral goal; the mention of a future painter was an intriguing hook.

arbitrary.text: Heating the crust to make moving plates initially felt like a leap, although the result clarified that plate motion involves forces and heat, not a global liquid ocean.

continue.text: Yes. The clear geological connections and the hint of a future painter make me curious about what the world will produce next.
